people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man in your house forever.
translations.bsb: You will see distress in My dwelling place. Despite all that is good in Israel, no one in your house will ever again reach old age.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation, in all the wealth which God shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever.
translations.asv: And thou shalt behold the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which God shall give Israel; and there shall not be an old man in thy house for ever.
